description: Extract full spoken transcript or AI video breakdown text from a YouTube URL/video ID (including Shorts) or direct HTTPS video URL so you can read, summarize, quote, or repurpose it into posts and articles.

language.description: Optional language code preference (e.g. en, nl, es)

prompt.description: Optional custom extraction or summary instruction (omit to extract the full spoken YouTube transcript)

url.description: YouTube watch/Shorts/youtu.be URL, 11-character YouTube video ID, or HTTPS video file URL

name: wordflux_video_to_text
